svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.51k stars in total, about 1.88k a year earlier. jactionlint 345, mr boxington 779, aube 2075, fnox 2409, hk 1346, pitchfork 719, usage 1080, +6 more 759.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
